status: Frozen paper research; on-demand recorder; no automation

strategies.signal: Recovered-protection Strong BOS detector from previous study; strict 2+2 swings, prior Wilder ATR14, penetration >=0.15 ATR, body >=0.8 ATR, directional close location >=0.75.
strategies.A: Entry at first 5m open after BOS confirmation.
strategies.B: Third 5m candle after BOS closes >=1 frozen pre-BOS ATR beyond broken level. Enter following 5m open, exactly 15m after A. No additional recross, FVG, or probability-score gate. A prior stop touch during waiting does not veto B: no order exists yet.
strategies.stops: Original BOS wick plus 0.10 frozen ATR. Distance floor is median range of 12 candles ending with BOS, frozen for both. Stop=max distance from actual modeled fill to anchor or frozen floor. Skip if reference entry is on invalid side of wick.
strategies.targets: 1.5 times actual fill-to-stop distance from actual fill. 120 minutes maximum from each strategy entry. No trailing, break-even, or volatility-based changes.
strategies.risk: 1R is fill-to-stop price distance before commission and exit slippage; costs can make loss >1R. Fixed dollar risk, continuous size, no leverage compounding. No claim of small-account lot-step or margin feasibility.

calendar: Retain ACG UTC Sun22:00-Fri22:00. Exclude entire signal-open-to-B-timeout window if overlapping20:45-23:15UTC. Actual Bybit holidays/sessions remain unverified.
features: No ATR-regime filter, FVG bonus, HTF filter, stop optimization or threshold changes. Record them only in separately versioned future research, not this test.
prospectiveBoundary: Only signals confirmed strictly after frozenAtUTC are eligible. Earlier candles are warm-up only. First-seen rows are immutable. Revisions logged without silently replacing prior evidence.
paperExecution: Twelve Data XAU/USD used as reference midpoint proxy, NOT Bybit broker feed. Commission0; fixed synthetic spread0.50USD/oz; adverse market/stop/time-exit slippage0.10USD/oz; target limit capped at1.5R. Entry is historical reference open at scheduled timestamp, not an actual executable fill. No live order capability.
observation: Actual first processing time is recorded independently for the signal, 15m acceptance update and entry-price evidence. Each is late above 90 seconds. Processing time is a conservative upper bound on provider response arrival. Timely simulated scheduled opens are still not observed fills.
positionPolicy: One simulated position per strategy. Skip entries in the same5m bucket as the previous exit, matching historical benchmark. Log every strong signal, including excluded, busy, rejected and unresolved cases.
dataGaps: Do not fill missing prices. Stop outcome resolution at the first missing required1m bar; flag data_gap. Native5m historical fallback is intentionally not used in this prospective journal. This stricter evidence rule is disclosed, not an entry-rule change.
review: At least 60 calendar days from actual cohort boundary AND 100 completed hypothetical trades in each central policy. Timely observation coverage and uncertainty must be reported; count threshold alone does not validate an edge.
normalization: Primary equal1R planned price risk per trade; also risk-hours, notional-hours, trade count, monthly sampling controls. Any ex-post scaling explicitly diagnostic, never a sizing recommendation.
commonHorizon: All Strong BOS signals, including A stopped before update. Signed reference open at signal+15m to close at signal+120m, minus scenario roundtrip spread, two market slippages and commission. Require all 105 one-minute bars. Separate eligible cohort from rollover exclusions.
readiness: Fresh in-session provider capture must succeed before cohort boundary. No scheduler is installed by this package.
primary: B minus A central net R at equal planned dollar risk per trade over common calendar period. Paired weekly uncertainty, stress sensitivity, exposure and drawdown mandatory. No causal attribution to acceptance alone.
